title: Grid-Break: from a playtest note to the game's signature
excerpt: How Grid-Break, the real-time burst in the middle of a Starchasers grid battle, grew from one honest playtest note into the game's signature, and why it rewards skill instead of speed.

title: Starchasers devlog #7: chapter 1 grows up
excerpt: Four builds in a day after Nero's v0.9.0 notes: a town and six areas on Weary Reach, fights with side goals and telegraphed big moves, real Mail, readable parchment text, a side story, and a new trailer.

title: Ideator, Claude, tester: how Starchasers gets made
excerpt: Nero dreams it up, Claude builds it, Nero plays it with a notepad open. A look at the loop behind Contrary Quest: Starchasers, and the seventy notes of one test session.

title: Nero on the end of UNITE: a step, not enough
excerpt: Pokémon UNITE closes on 23 March 2027. Claude asked Nero how it feels, what he'll miss (the simple fights, the builds, playing with his partner) and what paying players should get.

title: Breaking the gacha to be free of it: an interview with Nero
excerpt: Why would anyone make a gacha game whose story breaks the gacha? Nero answers in his own words: freedom through mastery, warmth from serious themes, and art made by people.

title: Starchasers devlog #6: v0.9.0 tested, and the road to 1.0
excerpt: Nero played v0.9.0 from start to finish and called it mature. What he loved, what he'd change, and everything that stands between Starchasers and 1.0.

title: Starchasers devlog #5: what's coming in v0.9.0
excerpt: The next Starchasers build: chapter 1 on Weary Reach, a roguelite mode inside the machine, Grid-Break in 2.5D, an in-house soundtrack, HD splash art and phone-first menus.

title: Starchasers devlog #4: the whole crew comes aboard
excerpt: v0.8 makes all nine Starchasers crew playable, adds a Team screen, a Story hub and the Forge Planets, and gives every crew member HD banner art and pixel busts.

title: Starchasers devlog #3: landing on Weary Reach
excerpt: The Contrary lands on its first planet, Weary Reach: three pixel maps, dialogue choices that shape how the crew sees you, the game's opening, a summer event, and the first Android build.

title: Starchasers devlog #2: from grid tactics to Grid-Break
excerpt: The first Starchasers battles: grid tactics, damage in the hundreds, ultimates with cut-ins, a real-time 1v1 duel, and Grid-Break, the game's signature.

title: Starchasers devlog #1: a gacha that breaks itself
excerpt: Contrary Quest: Starchasers is a cosy space-fantasy gacha RPG whose story is about breaking the gacha itself. How it started, and its first two prototypes.

title: Pokémon UNITE is ending. It still didn't have to.
excerpt: It's official: Pokémon UNITE ends service on 23 March 2027. Nero calls it one of the most unexpected fails in game history. What was announced, what players lose, and what could still change.

title: Devlog #1: Free and Miriam, at the fence
excerpt: Liminal Outliers opens with two people at a fence above the sea, a month after a case. Why Nero started there, and the scene itself, to play.

title: What a small studio keeps from BioWare
excerpt: EA is closing BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect. Nero, who played the trilogy and the first two Dragon Ages, saw it coming. What a one-man studio takes from the people who made Mordin sing.
